faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Young Professional post at CFQC&TI is 24th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Chemistry, M.Sc (Agriculture), M.Sc. with Microbiology, or M.Sc. Agri in Entomology from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 02 years of experience in the relevant field of Bio-stimulants/Nano fertilizers analysis and handling of relevant instruments is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional position is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Young Professional post at the Central Fertilizer Quality Control & Training Institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications, followed by an interview, and finally, the preparation of a merit list.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Central Fertilizer Quality Control & Training Institute located?
faq.answer: The Central Fertilizer Quality Control & Training Institute is located in Faridabad, Haryana, with the pincode 121001.
